title: hieracium arvicola
intro: Hieracium arvicola, commonly known as Mouse-ear hawk's-beard, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium arvicola include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
